- Intended wearer: adult

steps.userMessage:
STILLFORM | Sculptural rings for everyday stacking

We are developing three sculptural everyday rings, R1, R2 and R3, for adults who use jewellery to express personal style. Each must stand alone on the right middle finger and share a recognisable language of volume, negative space and surface. Explore two contrasting series directions and a third alternative, each containing all three rings, then select one. We are leaving the silhouettes and finish placement open. Print the name "STILLFORM" and the line "Separate forms, shared rhythm" on the single-ring portrait board and presentation cover.

The structural material is 925 silver, cast and then finished with polished, satin or intentionally oxidised surfaces. Each ring has a rigid, closed circular bore of diameter 18.0 mm, a maximum axial extent of 6.0 mm and an outer cylindrical envelope of diameter 28.0 mm. Load-carrying metal sections are at least 1.5 mm thick; skin-contact edges have a minimum radius of 0.5 mm. The fit profile has a resting finger diameter of 17.2 mm and knuckle diameter of 17.6 mm. Positive z runs from the palm-side base crease towards the fingertip: the wearing zone is z = 0–18 mm and all worn ring material sits within z = 2–16 mm, a 14 mm window. S12 places R1 then R2 from palm to fingertip on a relaxed open right hand; S23 places R2 then R3 in the same order on a right hand lightly gripping a plain cylinder of diameter 60 mm. Adjacent rings may touch, with their metal volumes remaining separate.

Audience: our studio and workshop will use the work to choose the series for sampling, with adult everyday wearers as the intended customers.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the project facts and fixed wording. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists every deliverable, its proportion, format and stage. client-fit-and-materials.en.md contains the fit coordinates, stack records and material boundaries. fit-reference.png is the constraint image for the coordinate system and dimensional envelopes. right-hand-study.png is the identity image for the wearer’s right hand and olive cuff, carried through the wearing boards and video. everyday-hand-movements.png is the reference image for neutral clothing, everyday gestures and lighting.

Deliverables:
1. A one-page materials and craft note covering 925 silver, casting and finishing, bore diameter, axial and radial limits, minimum metal thickness and skin-contact edge radius
2. Three series direction boards, one per direction, each showing R1, R2 and R3 and its proposed volume, negative-space and surface language
3. One selected-series rules board naming the chosen direction, shared features, ring differences, finish regions and the axial positions and rotations for S12 and S23
4. Three dimensioned technical sheets, one each for R1, R2 and R3, with front, side and axial views, contact sections and finish boundaries
5. One single-ring portrait board with three labelled views, showing R1, R2 and R3 individually on the right middle finger
6. Two stack wearing boards: S12 on the relaxed open right hand viewed obliquely from its back, and S23 on the right hand lightly gripping the 60 mm cylinder, each with an enlarged contact view and an axial placement diagram
7. One materials and surface sheet mapping the chosen finishes across all three rings, with enlarged skin-contact and ring-to-ring contact details
8. One 10-second wearing video showing S12 on the open right hand and S23 in the light cylinder grip
9. One presentation document of at least 8 pages, reusing the craft note, directions, selection, technical sheets, portraits, stacks, surface details and video stills

Acceptance:
- The three direction boards each contain R1, R2 and R3 and differ in volume, silhouette or negative-space organisation. The selected-series rules board identifies one direction and repeats the craft note's 925 silver, 18.0 mm bore and 6.0 mm maximum axial extent.
- The three technical sheets dimension the 18.0 mm bore, actual axial extent up to 6.0 mm, outer diameter up to 28.0 mm, load-carrying sections of at least 1.5 mm and skin-contact radii of at least 0.5 mm. The materials and surface sheet assigns a finish and region to every ring and repeats the metal thickness and edge-radius minima.
- The single-ring portrait board, both stack boards and wearing video preserve each technical sheet's silhouette, openings, feature positions and finish divisions. R2 has the same design in S12 and S23; all wearing views use the right hand and olive cuff from right-hand-study.png.
- Both stack boards label their palm-to-tip order, S12 as R1 then R2 and S23 as R2 then R3. Their placement diagrams repeat the selected-series board's positions and rotations, locate every part within z = 2–16 mm and show separate metal volumes at contact. S23 identifies the cylinder diameter as 60 mm.
- The 10-second wearing video contains both specified poses with readable ring identities and stacking order. The single-ring portrait board and presentation cover carry STILLFORM and Separate forms, shared rhythm with the stated spelling.
- The presentation contains at least 8 pages, names the selected direction on page 1, repeats 925 silver, 18.0 mm bore and 6.0 mm maximum axial extent from the craft note, and reuses every earlier deliverable through its pages and video stills.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
